description: Email System Phase 2 — non-technical authoring (TipTap branded-shell editor), newsletter subscribers with consent/unsubscribe, durable public image URLs, campaigns with rate-capped fan-out, blog-to-newsletter, CRM-lite. Source: tasks/prd-email-authoring-campaigns.md + docs/EMAIL-SYSTEM-REVIEW.md.

userStories.title: Newsletter subscribers model
userStories.description: As the platform, I need a tenant-scoped subscriber table so storefront signups persist.
acceptanceCriteria: Prisma model newsletter_subscribers: id, tenantId (FK tenants, cascade), email, status enum SubscriberStatus (PENDING|CONFIRMED|UNSUBSCRIBED|SUPPRESSED), source, consentAt, confirmedAt, unsubscribedAt, token (unique), createdAt, updatedAt
@@unique([tenantId, email]) and index on [tenantId, status]
Migration authored under prisma/migrations following existing pattern (do NOT run migrate dev against the configured DB — see PROMPT validation rules)
pnpm prisma validate and pnpm prisma generate pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Schema: nextjs_space/prisma/schema.prisma — follow existing snake_case model style (email_logs L31, email_templates L50). Migrations run on boot in deploy; no manual apply step. Wire the tenants relation like email_logs does.

userStories.title: Public subscribe endpoint + wire the storefront stubs
userStories.description: As a storefront visitor, I want my newsletter signup to actually register so the store can email me.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/storefront/newsletter/subscribe: public, tenant resolved from request host, zod-validated email, rate-limited with the existing rate-limit util
Upserts PENDING row with fresh token; never downgrades CONFIRMED/UNSUBSCRIBED status (unit test)
Response is generic success regardless of prior state (no subscriber enumeration)
components/sections/ctas/Newsletter.tsx and components/home/educational-content.tsx POST to the endpoint; failure shows an error state (success copy no longer lies)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass (targeted vitest run)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (fallback per PROMPT if dev server unavailable)
userStories.notes: Dead stubs: Newsletter.tsx:24-27 (setSubmitted only), educational-content.tsx:25-32 (toast only). Host-based tenant resolution: lib/tenant-resolver.ts / lib/parse-host.ts — same mechanism storefront pages use. Find the existing API rate-limit util (grep lib for rateLimit) before writing one.

userStories.title: Double opt-in confirmation
userStories.description: As a store owner, I want subscribers confirmed so my list is consented and deliverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Subscribe enqueues a confirmation email via sendEmail (templateName newsletterConfirm) containing the signed confirm link
GET /api/storefront/newsletter/confirm?token= sets CONFIRMED + confirmedAt, invalidates the token for reuse, redirects to the storefront with a notice
Expired/unknown token renders a friendly error, no state change
newsletterConfirm added to the tenant event allowlist and TenantEventMapper, with a seeded default template
Typecheck passes
Tests pass (targeted vitest run)
userStories.notes: Allowlist: app/api/tenant-admin/email-mappings/route.ts:15-23. Mapper UI: components/admin/email/TenantEventMapper.tsx:24-60. Seed pattern: scripts/seed-email-templates.ts (react-email component rendered with {{placeholder}} props). sendEmail: lib/email/email.ts:23.

userStories.title: Unsubscribe route + suppression enforcement
userStories.description: As a recipient, I want one-click unsubscribe that is honored on every future marketing send.
acceptanceCriteria: Prisma model email_suppressions: tenantId, email, reason (unsubscribed|bounced|manual), createdAt, @@unique([tenantId, email]); migration authored
GET /api/storefront/newsletter/unsubscribe?token= shows a confirmation page; POST with the same token unsubscribes — POST must work with no cookies/headers (RFC 8058 one-click target)
Unsubscribe sets subscriber UNSUBSCRIBED + writes a suppression row
Worker: jobs with category 'marketing' check suppression before sending; suppressed -> email_logs FAILED with reason 'suppressed', no send, no retry (return, don't throw)
Unit tests: suppression blocks marketing send; transactional sends unaffected; jobs without category default to transactional
Typecheck passes
Tests pass (targeted vitest run)
userStories.notes: Worker: scripts/email-worker.ts — add the check near the PRD-220 expiry guard (L76-81); mirror its return-not-throw pattern. Job payload gains optional 'category'; older in-flight payloads have none — must not break. Worker DB access must stay bypassTenantScope-safe (TENANT_CONTEXT_STRICT landmine, PR #209).

userStories.title: Durable public image URLs
userStories.description: As a tenant admin, I want uploaded images to keep working forever so emails and blog covers don't break after an hour.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/public/images/[...key] streams from S3, only under the tenants/{tenantId}/uploads/ prefix (reuse s3-tenant-guard assertion; reject path traversal)
Sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable and the correct Content-Type
Non-image keys rejected 404 (extension allowlist + content-type check); unknown key -> 404 without leaking S3 errors
Upload API responses include the durable URL alongside the presigned one
The Wire cover-image flow stores/uses the durable URL for new uploads (no backfill of old posts)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (image loads; check response headers)
userStories.notes: S3 client + presigned getFileUrl: lib/storage/s3.ts:29-130. Guard: lib/storage/s3-tenant-guard.ts. The upload route comment at app/api/tenant-admin/upload/route.ts:50-53 documents this exact follow-up. Wire cover upload: app/tenant-admin/the-wire/post-form.tsx:46-54.

userStories.title: Fan-out send with rate cap
userStories.description: As the platform, I must send one message per recipient, rate-limited per tenant, with progress and cancel — never a single message exposing all addresses.

Campaign auto-flips to SENT when no PENDING/QUEUED recipients remain; list/compose UI shows sent/failed/suppressed progress
POST /api/tenant-admin/campaigns/[id]/cancel sets CANCELLED; worker drops jobs whose campaign is cancelled (status check before send)
